role.en: Chief AI Architect, Alibaba; Head of Tongyi Large Model Division
role.zh: 阿里巴巴首席 AI 架构师；通义大模型事业部负责人

why.en: Built Qwen into one of the most downloaded and most-derived-from open model families on earth — the single largest source of China's open-model influence. Stepped out of the Alibaba Cloud CTO seat to focus purely on the model.
why.zh: 把通义千问 Qwen 做成全球下载量与衍生模型数量最大的开源模型家族之一，是中国开源模型影响力的主要来源。已卸任阿里云 CTO 职务，转向纯粹专注于模型本身。

title.en: Qwen3.7-Max: an agent model that runs 35 hours unattended
title.zh: Qwen3.7-Max：可无人值守运行 35 小时的 agent 模型

title.en: Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS across 16 languages
title.zh: Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS，覆盖 16 种语言

title.en: Libra: Taming Attention Workload Skew in Long-Context LLM Training with Bounded Sequence Pool
title.zh: Libra: Taming Attention Workload Skew in Long-Context LLM Training with Bounded Sequence Pool

note.en: Alibaba training-infrastructure paper he co-authors, showing that sequence packing leaves attention workload badly skewed in long-context LLM training and fixing it with a bounded sequence pool.
note.zh: 他参与署名的阿里训练基础设施论文，指出序列打包并未解决长上下文大模型训练中注意力负载严重倾斜的问题，并用有界序列池加以修正。

title.en: Video = World + Event Stream
title.zh: Video = World + Event Stream

note.en: Wan-Streamer v0.3 reframes Alibaba's native-streaming interaction model around a single idea — a video is a persistent world plus an event stream.
note.zh: Wan-Streamer v0.3 用一个统一视角重新表述阿里的原生流式交互模型：视频即持久世界加事件流。

title.en: WanSong v1.0 Technical Report
title.zh: WanSong v1.0 Technical Report

note.en: Technical report for WanSong v1.0, Alibaba's music generation foundation model, aimed at controllable high-fidelity long-form audio.
note.zh: 阿里音乐生成基础模型 WanSong v1.0 的技术报告，目标是可控的高保真长时音频生成。

title.en: QwenPaw-Data: Bridging Facts, Methodology, and Execution for Autonomous Enterprise Data Analytics
title.zh: QwenPaw-Data: Bridging Facts, Methodology, and Execution for Autonomous Enterprise Data Analytics

note.en: QwenPaw-Data treats enterprise data analysis as its own agent frontier, joining facts, methodology and execution into one autonomous analytics loop.
note.zh: QwenPaw-Data 把企业数据分析视为独立的智能体前沿，将事实、方法论与执行串成一条自主分析闭环。

title.en: ARMOR: Stabilizing On-Policy LLM RL with Off-Policy Anchor Samples
title.zh: ARMOR: Stabilizing On-Policy LLM RL with Off-Policy Anchor Samples

note.en: ARMOR stabilises the notoriously fragile on-policy RL stage of LLM reasoning training by anchoring it with off-policy samples.
note.zh: ARMOR 用离策略锚点样本稳定大模型推理训练中出了名脆弱的在策略强化学习阶段。

title.en: Wan-Streamer v0.2: Higher Resolution, Same Latency
title.zh: Wan-Streamer v0.2: Higher Resolution, Same Latency

note.en: Wan-Streamer v0.2 raises the interactive output resolution of Alibaba's real-time audio-visual model while holding latency at v0.1 levels.
note.zh: Wan-Streamer v0.2 在保持 v0.1 延迟水平的同时，提高了阿里实时音视频交互模型的输出分辨率。

title.en: Experience Augmented Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
title.zh: Experience Augmented Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning

note.en: Adds accumulated experience to reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, loosening RLVR's dependence on fresh on-policy rollouts alone.
note.zh: 在可验证奖励强化学习中引入累积经验，减轻 RLVR 只依赖当前在策略采样的局限。

title.en: Erase-then-Delta Attention: Decoupling Erase and Write Addresses in Delta-Rule Linear Attention
title.zh: Erase-then-Delta Attention: Decoupling Erase and Write Addresses in Delta-Rule Linear Attention

note.en: Linear-attention architecture work that decouples the erase and write addresses in delta-rule updates so corrections are no longer tied to the write position.
note.zh: 线性注意力架构研究，将 delta 规则更新中的擦除地址与写入地址解耦，使修正不再被绑定在写入位置上。

title.en: Perception, Verdict, and Evolution: Hindsight-Driven Self-Refining Forensics Agent for AI-Generated Image Detection
title.zh: Perception, Verdict, and Evolution: Hindsight-Driven Self-Refining Forensics Agent for AI-Generated Image Detection

note.en: A self-refining forensics agent for detecting AI-generated images, learning from hindsight over its own verdicts — Alibaba work on the deepfake problem its own generators create.
note.zh: 一个用于检测 AI 生成图像的自我精炼取证智能体，通过复盘自身判定结果持续改进——阿里针对自家生成模型带来的深度伪造问题所做的研究。

title.en: Wan-Streamer v0.1: End-to-end Real-time Interactive Foundation Models
title.zh: Wan-Streamer v0.1: End-to-end Real-time Interactive Foundation Models

note.en: Introduces Wan-Streamer, a native-streaming end-to-end foundation model built for low-latency full-duplex audio-visual interaction.
note.zh: 提出 Wan-Streamer，一个为低延迟全双工音视频交互而生的原生流式端到端基础模型。

title.en: Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents
title.zh: Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents

note.en: Qwen-AgentWorld studies world modelling in language, using an LLM to predict environment dynamics as the reasoning and planning core of general agents.
note.zh: Qwen-AgentWorld 研究语言形式的世界建模，用大模型预测环境动态，作为通用智能体推理与规划的核心机制。

title.en: Deeper is Not Always Better: Mitigating the Alignment Tax via Confident Layer Decoding
title.zh: Deeper is Not Always Better: Mitigating the Alignment Tax via Confident Layer Decoding

note.en: Challenges the assumption that the final layer decodes best, cutting the alignment tax by decoding from whichever layer is confident.
note.zh: 质疑“最后一层预测最可靠”的默认假设，改为从置信度足够的中间层解码，从而降低对齐税。

title.en: Connect the Dots: Training LLMs for Long-Lifecycle Agents with Cross-Domain Generalization Via Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: Connect the Dots: Training LLMs for Long-Lifecycle Agents with Cross-Domain Generalization Via Reinforcement Learning

note.en: Trains LLMs in the meta-skill of connecting evidence across a long deployment lifecycle, with reinforcement learning for cross-domain generalisation.
note.zh: 用强化学习训练大模型在漫长部署周期中“串联线索”的元能力，并实现跨领域泛化。

title.en: Qwen-RobotNav Technical Report: A Scalable Navigation Model Designed for an Agentic Navigation System
title.zh: Qwen-RobotNav Technical Report: A Scalable Navigation Model Designed for an Agentic Navigation System

note.en: Technical report for Qwen-RobotNav, a navigation model whose observation strategy can be reconfigured at inference time by the agent system above it.
note.zh: Qwen-RobotNav 技术报告：一个观察策略可由上层智能体系统在推理时重新配置的导航模型。

title.en: Qwen-RobotManip Technical Report: Alignment Unlocks Scale for Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models
title.zh: Qwen-RobotManip Technical Report: Alignment Unlocks Scale for Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models

note.en: Technical report for Qwen-RobotManip, arguing that aligning heterogeneous robot data under one formulation is what unlocks scale in manipulation models.
note.zh: Qwen-RobotManip 技术报告，论证在统一表述下对齐异构机器人数据，才是操作模型规模化的关键。

title.en: Qwen-RobotWorld Technical Report: Unifying Embodied World Modeling through Language-Conditioned Video Generation
title.zh: Qwen-RobotWorld Technical Report: Unifying Embodied World Modeling through Language-Conditioned Video Generation

note.en: Qwen-RobotWorld unifies embodied world modelling as language-conditioned video generation, predicting physically grounded future frames from an instruction.
note.zh: Qwen-RobotWorld 将具身世界建模统一为语言条件视频生成，根据指令预测符合物理规律的未来画面。

title.en: Breaking Entropy Bounds: Accelerating RL Training via MTP with Rejection Sampling
title.zh: Breaking Entropy Bounds: Accelerating RL Training via MTP with Rejection Sampling

note.en: Attacks the rollout bottleneck in LLM reinforcement learning by combining multi-token prediction with rejection sampling.
note.zh: 将多词元预测与拒绝采样结合，攻克大模型强化学习训练中的 rollout 瓶颈。

title.en: Qwen-Image-Flash: Beyond Objective Design
title.zh: Qwen-Image-Flash: Beyond Objective Design

note.en: Qwen-Image-Flash revisits few-step distillation for image generation by looking past the distillation objective itself.
note.zh: Qwen-Image-Flash 跳出蒸馏目标本身，重新审视图像生成的少步蒸馏加速方法。

title.en: Qwen-Image-Flash: Rethinking the Training Recipe for Few-Step Distillation
title.zh: Qwen-Image-Flash: Rethinking the Training Recipe for Few-Step Distillation

note.en: As part of the Qwen team, Zhou Jingren co-authored Qwen-Image-Flash, which rethinks the training recipe for distilling image generation models down to a few inference steps.
note.zh: 作为通义千问团队成员，周靖人参与撰写了Qwen-Image-Flash论文，重新设计了将图像生成模型蒸馏为少步推理的训练方案。

title.en: Qwen-VLA: Unifying Vision-Language-Action Modeling across Tasks, Environments, and Robot Embodiments
title.zh: Qwen-VLA: Unifying Vision-Language-Action Modeling across Tasks, Environments, and Robot Embodiments

note.en: Qwen-VLA unifies vision-language-action modelling across tasks, environments and robot bodies instead of training one specialised model per task.
note.zh: Qwen-VLA 跨任务、跨环境、跨机器人本体统一视觉-语言-动作建模，取代为每个任务单独训练专用模型的做法。

title.en: Clipping Bottleneck: Stabilizing RLVR via Stochastic Recovery of Near-Boundary Signals
title.zh: Clipping Bottleneck: Stabilizing RLVR via Stochastic Recovery of Near-Boundary Signals

note.en: Identifies clipping as a bottleneck in RLVR training and recovers the discarded near-boundary signal stochastically to stabilise it.
note.zh: 指出裁剪是 RLVR 训练的瓶颈，通过随机恢复被丢弃的边界附近信号来稳定训练。

title.en: One-Way Policy Optimization for Self-Evolving LLMs
title.zh: One-Way Policy Optimization for Self-Evolving LLMs

note.en: One-way policy optimisation addresses the sparsity of binary verifier rewards when scaling self-evolving LLM reasoning.
note.zh: 单向策略优化针对自进化大模型推理扩展中二元验证器奖励过于稀疏的问题。

title.en: A Few GPUs, A Whole Lotta Scale: Faithful LLM Training Emulation with PrismLLM
title.zh: A Few GPUs, A Whole Lotta Scale: Faithful LLM Training Emulation with PrismLLM

note.en: PrismLLM emulates thousand-GPU LLM training faithfully on a handful of GPUs, so framework debugging and tuning no longer needs the full cluster.
note.zh: PrismLLM 用少量 GPU 忠实模拟千卡规模的大模型训练，使框架调试与性能调优不再依赖整个集群。

title.en: Qwen-Scope: Turning Sparse Features into Development Tools for Large Language Models
title.zh: Qwen-Scope: Turning Sparse Features into Development Tools for Large Language Models

note.en: Qwen-Scope turns sparse-feature interpretability into practical development tooling for inspecting and steering Qwen models.
note.zh: Qwen-Scope 把稀疏特征可解释性研究变成可用的开发工具，用于检视和干预 Qwen 模型。

title.en: Qwen-Image-2.0 Technical Report
title.zh: Qwen-Image-2.0 Technical Report

note.en: Technical report for Qwen-Image-2.0, which folds high-fidelity generation and precise editing into a single image foundation model.
note.zh: Qwen-Image-2.0 技术报告：将高保真生成与精确编辑统一进同一个图像基础模型。

title.en: Accelerating Compound LLM Training Workloads with Maestro
title.zh: Accelerating Compound LLM Training Workloads with Maestro

note.en: Maestro speeds up compound training workloads such as distillation and multimodal training, where components differ sharply in scale.
note.zh: Maestro 加速蒸馏、多模态训练等各组件规模差异悬殊的复合式训练负载。

title.en: SWE-Universe: Scale Real-World Verifiable Environments to Millions
title.zh: SWE-Universe: Scale Real-World Verifiable Environments to Millions

note.en: Paper introducing SWE-Universe, a framework for scaling verifiable software-engineering training environments to millions for agent training.
note.zh: 论文提出SWE-Universe框架，将可验证的软件工程训练环境扩展到百万级规模，用于智能体训练。

title.en: XiYan-SQL: A Novel Multi-Generator Framework for Text-to-SQL
title.zh: XiYan-SQL: A Novel Multi-Generator Framework for Text-to-SQL

posts.source: IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Dat…

note.en: Technical paper on XiYan-SQL, Alibaba's multi-generator framework for text-to-SQL, published in IEEE TKDE.
note.zh: 发表于IEEE TKDE的技术论文，介绍阿里巴巴面向Text-to-SQL的多生成器框架XiYan-SQL。

title.en: Towards General Agentic Intelligence via Environment Scaling
title.zh: Towards General Agentic Intelligence via Environment Scaling

note.en: ACL paper on scaling training environments to build more general agentic intelligence, aligned with Alibaba's Tongyi agent research.
note.zh: ACL论文探讨通过扩展训练环境构建更通用的智能体能力，与阿里通义智能体研究方向一致。

title.en: Automated Profile Inference with Language Model Agents
title.zh: Automated Profile Inference with Language Model Agents

note.en: ACL paper on using language model agents to automate profile inference, part of Alibaba's agent research line.
note.zh: ACL论文研究利用语言模型智能体实现自动化画像推断，属于阿里智能体研究方向。

title.en: Nested Browser-Use Learning for Agentic Information Seeking
title.zh: Nested Browser-Use Learning for Agentic Information Seeking

note.en: Paper on nested browser-use learning methods for building agents that seek information autonomously online.
note.zh: 论文研究嵌套式浏览器使用学习方法，用于构建能自主在线检索信息的智能体。

title.en: MAI-UI Technical Report: Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
title.zh: MAI-UI Technical Report: Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents

note.en: Technical report on MAI-UI, a foundation model for real-world GUI agents that operate computer interfaces.
note.zh: MAI-UI技术报告，介绍一个面向真实场景GUI智能体、可操作电脑界面的基础模型。

title.en: Fun-Audio-Chat Technical Report
title.zh: Fun-Audio-Chat Technical Report

note.en: Technical report for Fun-Audio-Chat, part of Alibaba's FunAudioLLM open-source audio model line for conversational speech.
note.zh: Fun-Audio-Chat技术报告，属于阿里FunAudioLLM系列面向对话语音的开源音频模型。

title.en: VideoAgentTrek: Computer Use Pretraining from Unlabeled Videos
title.zh: VideoAgentTrek: Computer Use Pretraining from Unlabeled Videos

note.en: Paper on VideoAgentTrek, pretraining computer-use agents from unlabeled screen-recording videos.
note.zh: 论文提出VideoAgentTrek，利用无标注屏幕录制视频对电脑操作智能体进行预训练。

title.en: Qwen3.7-Max announced at the Alibaba Cloud Summit
title.zh: 阿里云峰会发布 Qwen3.7-Max

body.en: Positioned as a next-generation agent model: agentic coding, complex reasoning and long-horizon tasks, able to run autonomously for up to 35 hours without degradation. Zhou described it as top-tier on benchmarks and ahead of all other Chinese models.
body.zh: 定位为下一代 agent 模型：擅长 agentic coding、复杂推理与长程任务，可自主运行长达 35 小时而不衰减。周靖人称其在各项基准上位居第一梯队，并领先所有其他中国模型。

title.en: Alibaba forms Token Hub; Zhou named Chief AI Architect
title.zh: 阿里成立 Token Hub；周靖人出任首席 AI 架构师

body.en: The new unit pulls Tongyi, the MaaS line, Qwen, Wukong and AI Innovation under one roof.
body.zh: 新业务单元整合通义大模型事业部、MaaS 业务线、Qwen、悟空与 AI 创新。

title.en: 周靖人走下主舞台
title.zh: 周靖人走下主舞台

body.en: Reports say Zhou Jingren is stepping back from the public spotlight at Alibaba, following his earlier exit from the Alibaba Cloud CTO role.
body.zh: 有报道称周靖人正逐渐淡出公众视野，此前他已卸任阿里云CTO一职。

title.en: 阿里AI换将 周靖人淡出云栖主舞台背后
title.zh: 阿里AI换将 周靖人淡出云栖主舞台背后

body.en: Reports say Zhou Jingren is stepping back from Alibaba's public-facing AI leadership stage at Yunqi, suggesting an internal reshuffle worth confirming against his current registry role.
body.zh: 有报道称周靖人正淡出阿里云栖大会的公开AI领导舞台，暗示内部人事调整，需要核实其在注册信息中的当前职位。

title.en: 阿里巴巴周靖人现身外滩大会，周靖人：模型不理解个人是因为缺少上下文
title.zh: 阿里巴巴周靖人现身外滩大会，周靖人：模型不理解个人是因为缺少上下文

body.en: At the Bund Summit, Zhou Jingren outlined a trust framework for AI agents, arguing trust comes down to giving them clear constraints and a safe sandboxed execution environment, much like delegating a task to a person.
body.zh: 周靖人在外滩大会上提出智能体信任框架，认为让Agent获得信任的关键在于给予明确的约束条件和安全的沙箱执行环境，如同将任务委托给人一样。

title.en: 阿里巴巴首席科学家周靖人：Agent执行要有安全沙箱机制
title.zh: 阿里巴巴首席科学家周靖人：Agent执行要有安全沙箱机制

body.en: Zhou said AI agent execution needs a safety sandbox mechanism, addressing risk controls as Alibaba pushes agentic AI products.
body.zh: 周靖人表示，Agent（智能体）的执行需要具备安全沙箱机制，谈及阿里在推进智能体产品时的风险管控。

title.en: 阿里巴巴首席科学家周靖人：Agent执行要有安全沙箱机制
title.zh: 阿里巴巴首席科学家周靖人：Agent执行要有安全沙箱机制

body.en: Zhou said agent execution needs a secure sandboxing mechanism.
body.zh: 周靖人表示，Agent的执行需要具备安全沙箱机制。

title.en: 阿里巴巴首席科学家周靖人：Agent执行要有安全沙箱机制
title.zh: 阿里巴巴首席科学家周靖人：Agent执行要有安全沙箱机制

body.en: Zhou Jingren argued that AI agents need a safety sandbox mechanism for execution, a notable technical stance from Alibaba's chief AI architect.
body.zh: 周靖人提出智能体（Agent）执行需要建立安全沙箱机制，这是阿里巴巴首席AI架构师就相关技术安全问题给出的重要观点。

title.en: 阿里巴巴紧急回应：“首席科学家周靖人辞职”纯属谣言！“近几日有人在网络上组织扩散该谣言”
title.zh: 阿里巴巴紧急回应：“首席科学家周靖人辞职”纯属谣言！“近几日有人在网络上组织扩散该谣言”

body.en: Alibaba publicly denied reports that Zhou had resigned as chief scientist, calling the claim an organised rumour.
body.zh: 阿里巴巴公开否认周靖人辞任首席科学家的传闻，称该说法系有人有组织散布的谣言。

title.en: 周靖人担任阿里巴巴首席科学家；钉钉换帅；爱立信任命新任总裁兼CEO；苹果高管将离职加入OpenAI | 2026年6月全球科技企业高管变动
title.zh: 周靖人担任阿里巴巴首席科学家；钉钉换帅；爱立信任命新任总裁兼CEO；苹果高管将离职加入OpenAI | 2026年6月全球科技企业高管变动

body.en: Reports that Zhou Jingren was appointed Chief Scientist of Alibaba Group, a step up from his Alibaba Cloud CTO and Tongyi division role.
body.zh: 报道周靖人出任阿里巴巴集团首席科学家，较其此前的阿里云 CTO 与通义大模型业务负责人身份更进一步。

title.en: 阿里现任合伙人调整：CFO 徐宏、资深副总裁周靖人加入，邵晓锋退出
title.zh: 阿里现任合伙人调整：CFO 徐宏、资深副总裁周靖人加入，邵晓锋退出

body.en: Zhou Jingren joins the Alibaba Partnership alongside CFO Xu Hong as Shao Xiaofeng steps out — the technical leadership of Qwen moving into the group's governing body.
body.zh: 周靖人与 CFO 徐宏一同加入阿里巴巴合伙人，邵晓锋退出——通义与 Qwen 的技术负责人进入集团治理核心。

title.en: 阿里合伙人调整：邵晓锋退出，AI科学家周靖人、CFO徐宏加入！CEO吴泳铭年薪4.95亿元直管Token Foundry事业部
title.zh: 阿里合伙人调整：邵晓锋退出，AI科学家周靖人、CFO徐宏加入！CEO吴泳铭年薪4.95亿元直管Token Foundry事业部

body.en: Zhou Jingren joined Alibaba's partnership committee alongside CFO Xu Hong as Shao Xiaofeng exited, a formal elevation of his standing within the group.
body.zh: 邵晓锋退出阿里巴巴合伙人委员会，周靖人与CFO徐宏同时加入，标志着他在集团内地位的正式提升。

title.en: 阿里合伙人调整：邵晓锋退出，AI科学家周靖人、CFO徐宏加入！CEO吴泳铭直管Token Foundry事业部
title.zh: 阿里合伙人调整：邵晓锋退出，AI科学家周靖人、CFO徐宏加入！CEO吴泳铭直管Token Foundry事业部

body.en: Alibaba added Zhou Jingren to its senior partnership alongside CFO Xu Hong as Shao Xiaofeng exited, with CEO Eddie Wu taking direct oversight of the new Token Foundry unit.
body.zh: 阿里巴巴合伙人名单调整：AI科学家周靖人与CFO徐宏新晋合伙人，邵晓锋退出，CEO吴泳铭亲自分管新设立的Token Foundry事业部。

title.en: 阿里合伙人调整：AI科学家周靖人、CFO徐宏加入！CEO吴泳铭直管Token Foundry事业部
title.zh: 阿里合伙人调整：AI科学家周靖人、CFO徐宏加入！CEO吴泳铭直管Token Foundry事业部

body.en: Zhou was added to the Alibaba Partnership in an AI leadership reshuffle in which CEO Wu Yongming took direct control of the Token Foundry unit.
body.zh: 阿里合伙人名单调整，周靖人入选合伙人；同一轮调整中 CEO 吴泳铭直管 Token Foundry 事业部。
